verdict.rationale: Kommo is a CRM, so auto-enriching contact and company records is a fair question for it, but nothing in the evidence documents a built-in firmographic or contact enrichment feature. The CRM API, webhooks, widgets and marketplace integrations are developer building blocks or third-party routes, which earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have contact and company records auto-enriched with firmographic and contact data
